skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add text captions to my video with accurate timing — and get captioned vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-caption — Add Captions to Your Videos.

- Instantly add AI-generated text captions to MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud setup and secure session management; just upload and describe your request.
- Supports quick exports (1080p MP4 by default) with turnaround in 30–90 seconds.
- Clear feedback and robust error handling for uploads, exports, and credits.
- Effortless iterative editing: upload, caption, preview, refine, and export — all in chat.
- Ideal for creators who want fast, accurate captions without complex editing tools.
